# API SPEC

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

v1 has no API or server actions. Content helpers in /lib/content.ts (pure, synchronous):

- getStudio() → StudioInfo
- listMusicians(filter?: { genre?: string; featured?: boolean }) → Musician[]
- getMusicianBySlug(slug) → Musician | undefined
- getLineupForMusician(slug) → LineupSlot[]
- listAboutSections() → AboutSection[]
- getFestival() → Festival
- isFestivalUpcoming(now?: Date) → boolean
